courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Pharmacognosy of Chinese Medicines
courses.description: Pharmacognosy of Chinese Medicines introduces the characteristics and classification of herbal plants. In addition, it would introduce the harvesting, processing, storage, chemical composition, pharmacological effects of Chinese herbal medicines. It would also give information on the resources of Chinese herbal medicines in southern China, the efficacy and characteristics of Chinese herbal medicines in Hong Kong. This is the fundamental course for study of Chinese Medicines. After finishing the course, students are expected to master the basic knowledge for learning clinical applications of Chinese Medicines.
courses.learning_outcomes:
本科是中藥的入門基礎科目，期望學生能夠:

藥用植物學的分類方法及藥理作用；
闡明中藥炮制、加工、採收及儲存的目的;
闡明華南地區及香港中草藥資源，利用性狀鑑定的方法辨認香港藥常見的中草藥.
courses.course_syllabus:
中藥的定義、起源、發展; 中草葯現代發展的認識及宏觀分析。
傳統植物分類學及其在現代社會的了解和應用。
藥用植物學的不同分類
中草葯的分類方法和相關的應用範疇。
中藥的藥效，介紹毒性中藥的概念，並列舉香港列為受管制的中藥及其致毒原因
華南地區道地藥材、種類、分佈、可持續發展等
講解四十種香港常見的中草藥的品種、功效及性狀

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Emergency Medicine in Chinese Medicine
courses.description: Students are taught to deal with emergency situations in the setting of a Chinese medicine clinic. Basic knowledge of first aid is included in this course.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCM and MCM Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
學生在學習本課程後，應能夠：
1. 擴闊對中醫急重症的知識範圍；
2. 深化對臨床急症個案診斷技巧；
3. 了解中西醫結合在急症診治中的優勢和短處；
4. 熟習心肺復甦術。
courses.course_syllabus:
1. 中醫急重症診斷救治原則
2. 外感高熱中醫辨証救治
3. 中暑概念及中醫藥急救措施
4. 肺衰病象與呼吸衰竭概念及中醫藥切入防治
5. 暴喘（ARDS）的識別與中醫藥切入防治
6. 脫証與休克的概念、急救原則與中醫藥切入救治
7. 血証急救原則及中醫藥切入救治 (自學)
8. 神昏與意識障礙概念及中醫藥切入救治
9. 薄厥與高血壓腦病急救原則與中醫藥切入救治措施 (自學)
10. 卒中風與腦血管意外的中醫藥切入急救原則與方法
11. 卒心痛與心絞痛、心肌梗死的診斷及中醫藥切入救治
12. 心衰病象與心功能衰竭的中醫切入防治
13. 腎衰病象與腎功能衰竭概念及中醫藥切入防治
14. 現代醫學疾病中的抽搐與中醫辨証及針灸救治方法
15. 卒腹痛與急腹症的概念、鑒別診斷及中醫藥切入防治
16. 卒死與心跳驟停
17. 心肺復甦理論與方法
18. 現場心肺複蘇操作方法實踐
19. 急性中毒的救治原則與中醫藥切入救治
20. 中藥中毒的臨床表現及救治原則

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Fundamental Diagnostic Radiology
courses.description: This course introduces radiology of the human body structure and organs and how the images facilitate the diagnosis of illnesses through better understanding of the anatomy, physiological functions and pathological changes of the human body. Topics include: diagnostic radiology, the theory of x-ray images, the concept of density and the applications on the respiratory system, the circulation system, the digestive system, the urological system and the musculo-skeletal system.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCM and MCM Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes: This module can help the Chinese Medicine students to enhance their clinical diagnostic skills. There are four diagnostic methods in Chinese medicine including observation, olfaction and auscultation, inquiring and palpation. Diagnostic radiology can widen the horizon and enhance the diagnostic confidence of Chinese medicine nowadays.
courses.course_syllabus:
(1) X線的特性、診斷原理、檢查方法及x 線分析的要點

(2) 骨關節損傷疾患放射學診斷: 常見頭頸、胸脊、上肢、下肢、骨盆部位之骨折、脫位、筋傷之診斷, 並作為中醫骨傷科學四診合參及辨證論治的補充診斷.

(3) 介紹呼吸系統的影像診斷提要、檢查方法、正常影像表現及常見病變影像診斷 (肺部、支氣管阻塞改變、胸膜改變、肺結核、肺炎肺腫瘤等等)

(4) 介紹中樞神經系統及頭頸的影像診斷提要、檢查方法、正常影像表現及常見病變影像診斷(中風、腦瘤、創傷、鼻煙癌等等)

(5) 介紹循環系統的影像診斷提要、檢查方法、正常影像表現及常見病變影像診斷(心臟增大、風濕心、高血壓性心臟病等等)

(6) 介紹消化系統的影像診斷提要、檢查方法、正常影像表現及常見病變影像診斷(膽囊結石、十二指腸球部潰瘍、食管異物、食管癌、胃潰瘍胃癌等等)

(7) 介紹泌尿系統的影像診斷提要、檢查方法、正常影像表現及常見病變影像診斷(泌系結石、尿路梗阻、腎盂積水、泌尿系結核、泌尿系腫瘤等等)

(8) 介紹骨骼系統的影像診斷提要、檢查方法、正常影像表現及常見病變影像診斷（骨質疏鬆、佝僂病、關節疾患、骨折、骨骼系統腫瘤等等）
courses.feedback_evaluation: Students' comments and feedback are welcome. Idea and suggestions can be communicated to the teacher or teaching assistant through telephone calls, emails, and/or meetings. Class representatives are encouraged to collect feedback from the class.

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Five Movements and Six Qi
courses.description: This course introduces the students about the basic concepts and theory of ‘Five-Movement and Six-Qi’ in Chinese medicine. This theory is used to explain and analyze the way to deals with the relationship between human being and climatic variations. The emphasis is placed on the climatic changes and their influence on the occurrence of diseases, in particular epidemic diseases.
courses.learning_outcomes: 在完成這課程後，期望學生能夠掌握運氣學說的基本理論、方法和臨床應用的要點。
courses.course_syllabus:

五運運行規律
六氣運行規律
運與氣相互作用的類型及臨床意義
古人對運氣學說的臨床運用經驗
運氣辨証治療規律和特點

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: A Comparative Study of the Traditional Chinese and Western Medical System
courses.description: This course introduces to students the differences between traditional Chinese and Western Medical Systems by comparing their culture, history, scientific background, fundamental principles, treatment methods and present status. This course also looks into the differences between Chinese and Western drugs and their therapeutic applications.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCM and MCM Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
學生在學習本課程之後，應能夠：
1. 講述西醫學的診治思路；
2. 講述中醫學的診治思路；
3. 分析中醫學診治思路中的問題、及形成原因。
courses.course_syllabus:
第1部分 - 引言
1. 問題的存在
2. 比較法原則

第2部分 - 診斷什麽
1. 從臨床案例提取診治思路
2. 相關問題延展討論
- “診斷什麽”思路·診病
- “診斷什麽”思路·診人
- 診病與診人關係
- 病與人各有規律，缺一不可

第3部分 - 如何診斷
1. 中醫學與哲學的關係問題
2. 臓腑問題
3. 外感熱性病的問題
4. 其它

第4部分 - 治什麽
1. 無非治病、與治人
2. 但診斷是發現。治療是發明。發明是無中生有。難度不一
3. 現實是，治療思路尚未形
4. 現階段只能收集資料，歸納、分析治療機理所涉類別

第5部分 - 如何治
1. 如果辨證論治是“白天鵝”，“黑天鵝”是否存在？有哪些？
2. 異病同治的構成
3. 方劑是中醫藥物學的主體形式
4. 其它

第6部分 - 中醫學概念
1. 當前概念裏的問題
2. 應從與主流醫學的關係處定義
3. 是診治皆以側重人體自身抗病能力爲特點的臨床醫學

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Clinical Thinking Skills in Chinese Medicine
courses.description:
Clinical reasoning strategies are essential for proper diagnosis and appropriate treatment regimen in Chinese Medicine. In this course, students will learn and discuss how featured clinical reasoning skills of Chinese Medicine could be applied throughout the clinical process, from diagnosis to prescription of herbs, basing on the study of real clinical cases.

By specifying the clinical reasoning strategies through the consolidation of the fundamental knowledge of Chinese Medicine, students shall be able to tackle the problems in the future clinical subjects by proper reasoning according to the principles and theories of Chinese Medicine.
courses.learning_outcomes:
学生在学习本科目之后，应能够：
1）运用中医基础知识与中医思维方法，仔细描述临床辨证论治的过程。
2）综合运用中医基础与临床科目的思维，分析辨证论治在现代临床运用过程中的常见问题。
courses.course_syllabus:
1) 中医的思维方法特点
2) 证候与四诊
3) 初步病机、临床病机与核心病机
4) 治则与方药
5) 诊后医嘱、调摄与养生
6) 外感病的诊治特点
7) 儿科与妇科的诊治特点
8) 在临床中学习经典的思路与方法
9) 在临床中累积经验的思路与方法
10) 中医与西医配合的思路

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Classical Prescriptions and Medical Records
courses.description: The course introduces classical prescriptions and medical records written by renowned Chinese Medicine Practitioners in Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing Dynasties. Students will analyze the logic and clinical application of the classical prescriptions and medical records, which will further enhance their learning in differential diagnosis.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCME and MCMED Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
學生在學習本科之後，應能夠：
1. 瞭解經方的原始出處；
2. 熟悉經方的配伍原理；
3. 熟悉經方的古今臨床應用；
4. 掌握名家醫案的運用技巧；
5. 掌握名家運用經方的真諦和體悟。
courses.course_syllabus:
1. 醫案概說
2. 百病生於氣理論

4. 陽道實陰道虛理論

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Basic and Clinical Toxicology of Chinese Medicines
courses.description: The main objective of this course is to enable the students to understand the concepts and mechanisms of toxicity and adverse effects of Chinese medicines. This course will introduce the basic principles and the history of toxicology of Chinese medicines, the toxic components of Chinese medicines, the mechanisms of toxicity of Chinese medicines, interaction between Chinese medicines and Western medicines, as well as the classification, management, clinical application, safety handling and adverse reaction and toxicity of Chinese medicines. This course is expected to equip students with the foundation of studying clinical safety use of Chinese medicines.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCME and MCMED Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
學生在學習本課程之後，應能夠：
1. 掌握中藥毒理學的理論及其現代研究的臨床應用、研究和學習的任務；
2. 要充分了解50 種毒性中藥，了解植物的來源、主要作用、成分、特徵、毒理作用和機理，熟悉50 種有毒中藥的分類、來源、藥理作用、作用機理和現代應用，了解25 種常用的毒性中藥的來源、主要成分和毒理作用，了解中藥和西藥之間的相互作用；
3. 使學生能夠利用毒性中藥的基本和臨床知識來找出和解決中藥的中毒問題；
4. 了解各種臨床負面影響和中毒病例，以掌握對中藥的不良反應和中毒的分析技能。
courses.course_syllabus:
1. 中藥毒理學歷史及演變
2. 毒性中藥的分類及臨床應用
3. 中藥不良反應、中毒的原因、症狀及防治
4. 中西藥交互作用
5. 代表性毒性中藥1
6. 代表性毒性中藥2

courses.subject: BCME
courses.title: Seminars on Chinese Medicine
courses.description: This course provides opportunities for students to broaden their view through attending lectures delivered by professors/experts on diverse topics including Chinese culture, Chinese medicine theory, diagnosis, treatment, formula, Chinese materia medica, acupuncture & moxibustion, clinical thinking skills and integrative medicine. Elements of modern development and innovation of Chinese medicine and global entrepreneurship related to Chinese medicine will also be covered. Students can get in depth to certain topic through various teaching and learning activities such as practicing particular skills under supervision and guidance of professors/experts in tutorials, sharing and discussion in tutorials and through online platform.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MSc Chinese Medicine
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本科目後，學生應能：
1. 闡述各專題講座的精要內容。
2. 聯繫專題所述的內容，搜索相關資料，延伸學習和討論。
3. 比較分析不同的觀點，申明其理據。
4. 演釋個人學術觀點，並分析和評價不同觀點。
courses.course_syllabus:
1. 中西醫協作的方式與挑戰。

2. 濕疹用藥體會及實驗研究結果的臨床應用。

3. 活血化瘀法婦科臨床應用要略。

4. 中西醫治療大腸癌初探。

5. 帕金森症（PD）的中醫臨床治療與研究。

6. 孟河醫派的學術特點和經驗分析。

7. 嶺南針灸發展史。

8. 靳三針療法臨床應用。

9. 針灸治療腦病。

10. 調神針法治療神志病。

11. 刺絡拔罐法臨床應用。

12. 肺系病診治。
